POETRY_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install POETRY. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.

POETRY_HOME.description: Directory where Poetry will be installed. Defaults to ~/.local or %APPDATA%\pypoetry.

POETRY_VERSION.description: Specific version of Poetry to install.
